blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in world models are opening new possibilities for fine-grained embodied tasks, with hand-object interaction offering a particularly demanding setting. Modeling these interactions involves capturing how hand actions change objects and how the resulting states persist over time. Yet systematic evaluation tailored to these hand-centric capabilities remains underdeveloped. To address this gap, we introduce HandWorldBench, a unified benchmark that systematically evaluates hand-centric world models across human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands along six dimensions: visual quality, hand fidelity, appearance consistency, instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence. To construct the benchmark, we develop a data curation pipeline that extracts hand-object interaction clips and screens them for quality, yielding 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips from over 600 hours of footage. We then manually select 500 clips covering seven task families for evaluation. Benchmarking eleven models under a unified protocol reveals that stronger hand-pose control does not consistently translate into coherent object-state evolution and persistence or robust cross-embodiment performance, with several specialized hand-control models underperforming general-purpose text/image-to-video generators on dexterous-hand tasks.
blocks.zh: 世界模式最近的进展为精心设计的任务开辟了新的可能,手物交互提供了特别苛刻的环境。 模拟这些相互作用涉及掌握手动如何改变物体,以及由此产生的状态如何长期存在。 然而,针对这些以手为中心的能力进行的系统评价仍然不足。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了HandWorld Bench这个统一的基准,它系统地评价了整个人类手掌的手心世界模型,模拟了柔软的手掌,以及真实的柔软的手掌,沿着六个维度:视觉质量,手心忠诚,外观一致性,跟随指令,物理一致性,以及时间一致性. 为了构建基准,我们开发了一个数据解析管道,提取手目标交互剪辑并进行质量筛选,从600多小时的镜头中产生20,500个高质量的自我中心剪辑. 然后我们手动挑选500个短片,涉及七个任务领域,以供评估。 对统一协议下的11个模型进行基准分析表明,加强手提式控制并非始终如一地转化为一致的物体状态演化和持久性或强健的交叉化性能,若干专业的手提式控制模型表现不佳的通用文本/图像到视频生成器执行非曲直的手提式任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Interactive world models are evolving from open-world exploration toward fine-grained embodied interaction.
Advances in generating action-controllable environments have established a foundation for predicting visual experience under user intervention [ 2 , 17 ] .
In embodied tasks, this prediction must capture how an agent’s actions change the objects it engages with.
Hand–object interaction brings this requirement into focus: hands support varied contacts and transformations, connecting egocentric experience to dexterous manipulation.
This connection has motivated growing interest in hand-centric world models.
blocks.zh:
互动的世界模式正在从开放世界的探索演变为精细的内在互动。
创造可控制行动环境方面的进展为预测用户干预下的视觉经验奠定了基础[2、17]。
在包含的任务中,这种预测必须捕捉代理人的行为如何改变它所接触的对象。
手 - 对象交互将这个要求引出焦点:手支持各种接触和转变,将自我中心的经验连接到狡猾的操纵上.
这种联系促使人们越来越关注以手为中心的世界模式。

blocks.en:
A growing body of work extends world modeling from locomotion and robotic-arm manipulation to hand-centric interaction.
Recent methods use meshes, joints, and poses to control hand motion [ 25 , 30 , 6 , 5 ] .
Contact and scene modeling support object interaction and continued manipulation [ 12 , 11 , 7 ] , with applications to data synthesis and digital teleoperation [ 6 , 31 ] .
Yet these advances are largely assessed through model-specific tasks and validation targets, making progress across methods difficult to compare.
This growing field still lacks a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation across tasks and embodiments.
blocks.zh:
不断增长的作品将世界建模从运动和机器人-武器操纵扩展到手心互动.
最近的方法使用 meshes, 关节, 和姿势来控制手动 [25, 30, 6, 5].
联系和场景建模支持对象交互和持续操纵[12,11,7],应用数据合成和数字远程操作[6,31].
然而,这些进展主要是通过具体模式的任务和验证目标加以评估的,因此难以比较各种方法的进展情况。
这一日益扩大的领域仍然缺乏一个用于对各项任务和表现进行系统评价的统一基准。

blocks.en:
Existing video and world-model benchmarks evaluate visual quality, interaction and navigation control, and embodied utility [ 8 , 29 , 4 , 13 ] .
Manipulation-focused benchmarks further assess physical executability, human-to-robot transfer, and agreement with real executions [ 9 , 20 , 3 ] (Table 1 ).
These benchmarks provide evidence about interaction quality and task outcomes; comparing hand-centric models further requires resolving how the prescribed motion produces those outcomes.
Small finger contacts can determine an operation’s outcome, while occlusion requires object states and previously observed details to remain consistent when they reappear.
Coordinated finger motions also make control fidelity consequential: similar overall hand movements can differ in joint configuration, contact location, and object response.
Evaluation must distinguish errors in following the supplied control from errors in the resulting interaction, using correspondences between native control inputs and generated motion.
These judgments must extend across human hands and simulated and real dexterous hands with different morphologies and kinematics, as well as operations with different completion and persistence requirements.
Existing protocols have yet to organize these requirements into a common evaluation of hand-centric world models.
blocks.zh:
现有视频和世界模型基准评价视觉质量、互动和导航控制,并体现效用[8、29、4、13]。
以操纵为重点的基准进一步评估实体可执行性、人对机器人的转移以及同意实际处决[9、20、3](表1)。
这些基准提供了互动质量和任务结果的证据;比较手心模型进一步要求解决规定的运动如何产生这些结果。
小指接触可以决定一个操作的结果,而隔离则需要对象状态和以前观察到的细节在重新出现时保持一致.
相协调的指动也使控制忠心性产生结果:类似的整体手动在联合配置,接触位置,和物体反应方面可能有所不同.
评价必须利用本地控制输入和生成运动之间的通信,区分所提供控制之后的错误和由此产生的相互作用中的错误。
这些判断必须延伸至人类的手和模拟而真实的有不同形态和动能的手,以及不同完成和持久性要求的操作.
现有协议尚未把这些要求组织成对以手心为中心的世界模式的共同评价。

blocks.en:
We introduce HandWorldBench , a unified benchmark for hand-centric world models across human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands.
Our data curation pipeline yields 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips from over 600 hours of footage.
From this corpus, we manually select 500 clips spanning seven task families to form the evaluation set.
To compare methods across embodiments, we establish shared structural semantics and spatiotemporal correspondences, then adapt the resulting controls to each model’s native interface.
Task annotations connect action requirements to evidence of object-state changes, subsequent persistence, and the preservation of previously observed details.
Our six-dimensional protocol combines visual and geometric measurements with these task-specific judgments to evaluate generated interactions under shared scoring criteria.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了HandWorld Bench, 一个统一的基准 以手为中心的世界模型 横跨人类的手, 模拟出有德性的手, 和真正的有德性的手。
我们的数据解析管道从600多小时的镜头中产生出20,500个以自我为中心的高质量剪辑.
从这本书中,我们手动选择了500个片段,涉及7个任务家庭,组成了评价集.
为了比较各种表征的方法,我们建立了共同的结构语义学和spatiotopal函式,然后使由此产生的控制适应每个模型的本地界面。
任务说明将动作要求与对象状态变化的证据,随后的持久性,以及保留先前观察到的细节联系起来.
我们的六维协议将视觉测量和几何测量与这些任务特定的判断结合起来,在共享评分标准下评价产生的相互作用.

blocks.en:
Our evaluation of eleven models shows that stronger hand-pose control can coexist with weak object-state evolution and persistence.
Several specialized hand-control models also underperform general-purpose text/image-to-video generators on dexterous-hand tasks.
These findings identify a gap between motion control and interaction prediction: realizing a prescribed movement does not ensure that its consequences are modeled coherently, and specialization in hand control does not ensure robust performance across embodiments.
blocks.zh:
我们对11个模型的评估表明,更强的手头控制可以与弱的物体状态进化和持久性并存.
一些专业的手控模型也表现不佳,无法完成脱口而出的任务。
这些调查结果查明了运动控制和相互作用预测之间的差距:实现规定的运动并不能保证其后果得到连贯的模拟,手控的专业化不能确保各表现体的强劲表现。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A unified benchmark. HandWorldBench establishes common interaction tasks and six evaluation dimensions for comparing world models across human hands and simulated and real dexterous hands. • A data curation pipeline and corpus. We construct high-quality interaction data through quality screening and signal-alignment checks, producing 20,500 clips from which we manually select 500 for evaluation. • A systematic evaluation. We systematically evaluate 11 representative models under a unified protocol, characterizing their performance across hand-centric tasks and embodiments.
blocks.zh: • 统一基准。 HandWorld Bench建立了共同的交互任务和6个评价维度,用于在人手和模拟而真实的有弹性的手身上比较世界模型. • 数据整理程序和程序。 我们通过质量筛选和信号对接检查构建高质量的互动数据,制作出20,500个剪辑,我们从中手动选择500个用于评价. 二. 支助 系统评估。 我们根据一项统一协议系统地评价11个代表性模式,说明这些模式在以手为中心的任务和表现方面的表现。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Controllable hand–object generation combines motion constraints with scene modeling.
Projected meshes, sparse joints, and pose-based rendering provide explicit motion constraints within visually conditioned generation [ 25 , 30 , 6 ] .
The interaction model determines how this prescribed motion affects objects: contact-aware embeddings encode geometric and kinematic priors, while scene-conditioned generation anchors the interaction to surrounding geometry [ 12 , 11 ] .
Explicitly updating the underlying scene state carries these effects into later interactions [ 7 ] .
Applications to pose-estimation data synthesis and digital teleoperation connect generated interactions to downstream learning [ 6 , 31 ] .

blocks.en:
Video-quality benchmarks organize perceptual, temporal, and semantic diagnostics, extending to anatomical, physical, and commonsense assessments of plausible world behavior [ 8 , 32 ] .
Interactive benchmarks test instruction-driven transitions and cross-turn consistency [ 29 ] , with navigation protocols additionally linking action-following accuracy to spatial memory on return paths [ 4 ] .
Embodied benchmarks assess the utility of predictions for data synthesis, planning, and policy learning across modalities and platforms [ 21 , 13 ] .
Manipulation evaluation adds physical execution and task-specific references: simulation replay tests whether generated behavior can be executed [ 9 ] , transfer annotations test preservation of goals and functional contacts across embodiments [ 20 ] , and paired real executions test the predicted effects of specified actions [ 3 ] .
HandWorldBench unifies hand-control, object-state, and memory assessment across human and dexterous hands.

健全的基准评估预测对跨模式和平台的数据综合、规划和政策学习的效用[21、13]。
操纵评价增加了物理执行和任务特定参考:模拟重放测试是否可被执行生成的行为 [9],转移说明测试目标保存和功能接触跨表现 [20],并配对真实执行测试特定动作的预测效果 [3].

blocks.en: 3 HandWorldBench
blocks.zh: 3个手球

blocks.en:
We construct HandWorldBench by curating egocentric interaction data across embodiments (Section 3.1 ), organizing model inputs through unified control interfaces, and establishing task annotations (Section 3.2 ).
We evaluate the generated interactions with seventeen metrics across six dimensions (Section 3.3 ), then aggregate these measurements into category scores and HWBScore for model comparison (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们设计了HandWorld Bench系统,其方法是整理自相矛盾的相互作用数据(第3.1节),通过统一控制接口组织模型输入,并制定任务说明(第3.2节)。
我们评价在6个维度(第3.3节)上与17个度量衡产生的相互作用,然后将这些测量结果汇总为类别分数和HWBS分数,用于模型比较(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集建设

blocks.en:
Figure 2 (a) outlines data curation from our in-house human-hand recordings, HandsOn [ 16 ] (simulated dexterous hands), and our own real dexterous-hand recordings.
Starting from over 600 hours of footage across the three embodiments, we validate video readability, timestamps, and alignment with available hand and camera signals.
Screening checks camera stability, hand visibility, and image quality.
Visual checks assess blur, exposure, and hand size.
We extract continuous clips of 80 ​ n + 1 80n+1 frames ( n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 ), screen for overlapping sources and visual duplicates, and check exported frame counts and signal correspondence.
Source intervals and available validity masks accompany each clip throughout processing.
From 20,500 curated clips, we manually select 500 for evaluation using the criteria in Appendix A.3; 20,000 remain for non-test use.
Evaluation cases cover seven task families and 22 task categories (composition, durations, and coverage in Appendices D.1–D.3), including material shaping, tools and mechanisms, and object handling (Figure 2 , right).

blocks.en: 3.2 Control Interfaces and Annotations
blocks.zh: 3.2 控制接口和说明

blocks.en:
We unify control through native-signal parsing, structural normalization, spatiotemporal alignment, and model-specific encoding (Figure 2 (b)).
Human-hand inputs provide native 3D keypoints, left/right validity, camera calibration, and visual-inertial odometry poses.
For dexterous hands, forward kinematics uses joint states, palm poses, and robot assets to obtain landmarks and surfaces, which are transformed into camera coordinates.
Each hand follows a fixed 21-point order: one wrist or palm anchor and four landmarks per finger, with hand identity and validity retained alongside native kinematics and surface geometry.
Human meshes are fitted to keypoints or visually reconstructed as required.
Coordinates use meters, explicit world-to-camera transforms, and image-matched projection and viewport mappings.
Source frame indices, timestamps, and shared inference windows align images, geometry, and cameras.
Adapters encode these assets as skeletal videos, 3D joints, surface renderings, or scene conditions for each model.
The common interface establishes structural and spatiotemporal correspondence while preserving each model’s conditioning format.
blocks.zh:
我们通过本地信号解析、结构正常化、瞬间对接和模式特有编码统一控制(图2(b))。
人手输入提供了原生的3D键点,左/右有效性,相机校正,视觉惯性偏振等姿势.
对于有德性的手,前向运动体使用联合状态,棕榈姿势,以及机器人资产来得到地标和地表,这些地标被转化为相机坐标.
每只手遵循一个固定的21分顺序:一腕或掌上锚和一指四个地标,与本土动能和地表几何学一起保留了手特征和有效性.
人膜安装在指针上,或按需要进行视觉重建。
坐标使用仪表,清晰的世界到相机变换,以及图像相配的投影和取景点映射.
源帧指数,时间戳,共享推论窗口对接图像,几何和相机.
适配器将这些资产编码为骨骼视频,3D关节,表面渲染,或每个模型的场景条件.
通用接口在保留每个模型的调制格式的同时,建立结构与相通的函式.

blocks.en:
Shared operation categories, global task descriptions, and segmented action descriptions establish task semantics across embodiments (Figure 2 (c)).
Evaluation annotations anchor action requirements and state checkpoints to the same manipulated object and its before, during, and after windows, distinguishing minimum change from full completion.
Persistence checks follow state establishment to identify unsupported reversals.
Memory annotations specify local attributes and history, occlusion, and reappearance windows; evaluation first verifies a hiding-and-return opportunity, then compares separately observed historical and returning attributes.
Human reviewers verify task descriptions, object states, and evaluation evidence against reference frames (Figure 2 (d); schemas and examples in Appendices C.1 and C.3).
Appendices B.4 and G.2 detail control adaptation and model information access.
blocks.zh:
共享的操作类别、全球任务说明和分门别类的行动说明确立了各种表现方式的任务语义(图2(c))。
评价说明将行动要求和国家检查站固定在同一被操纵物体及其窗口前后、期间和之后,区别最小变化和完全完成。
持久性检查跟随州立机构,以识别无支持倒置.
内存说明指定了局部属性和历史,隐蔽,再现等窗口;评价首先验证了隐藏和回回的机会,然后分别比较观察到的历史属性和回回回属性.
人类审查人员对照参考框架核实任务说明、对象状态和评价证据(图2(d);附录C.1和C.3中的计划和实例)。
附录B.4和G.2详细介绍了控制适应和模型信息访问.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价计量

blocks.en:
We organize 17 metrics into six dimensions that characterize visual quality, hand fidelity, appearance consistency, instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence.
Task-specific evaluation uses reference-defined cases and their annotated temporal windows.
Semantic metrics use local Qwen3.5-9B [ 18 ] with fixed task-specific rubrics; Appendix F details computations, rubrics, and scales for all seventeen metrics.
Individual-metric checks are described in Appendix J.3.
blocks.zh:
我们把17个度量衡组织成6个维度,这些维度具有视觉质量、手性、外观一致性、遵循指示、身体一致性和时间一致性的特点。
针对特定任务的评价使用参考定义的案例及其附加说明的时间窗口.
语义计量法使用有固定任务特定分号的本地Quen3.5-9B [18]; 附录F详细计算,分号,以及所有17个分号的分号.
附录J.3介绍了个人计量检查。

blocks.en:
MUSIQ [ 10 ] measures perceptual image quality; Visual Plausibility assesses visible physical artifacts with WBench’s dedicated reward model [ 29 , 26 ] .
JEPA Similarity measures collection-level similarity between generated and reference video distributions using JEDi [ 15 ] , V-JEPA features [ 1 ] , and WorldArena’s temporal sampling protocol [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh:
MUSIQ [10] 测量能感知到的图像质量;可视性用W Bench的专用奖励模型评估可见的物理文物[29,26].
JEPA用JEDi[15],V-JEPA的特征[1],以及WorldArena的"时间采样协议"[21]来测量生成和参考视频发行之间的收集级别相似性.

blocks.en:
Pose Control measures agreement with reference keypoint positions using a capped image-space distance, with zero credit for missing predictions.
Keypoint Coverage measures the fraction of reference-valid, in-frame keypoints recovered by the detector, including geometrically valid occluded points.
Hand Morphology uses the VBench-2.0 hand classifier [ 32 ] to estimate anatomical plausibility in the human-hand subset.
blocks.zh:
Pose Control度量衡协议与使用被封顶的图像-空间相距的参考键点位置,缺失的预测值为零.
关键点覆盖度测量了探测器所回收的参照-验证-内侧关键点的分量,包括几何上有效的偶入点.
手部摩托学使用V Bench-2.0手部分类器 [32] 来估计人手子集中的解剖学可信度.

blocks.en:
Entity Consistency compares CLIP features [ 19 ] of reference-defined hands and manipulated objects, with penalties for missing predicted regions.
Background Consistency measures the temporal stability of DINOv3 features [ 22 ] over background regions.
Photometric Consistency uses Depth Anything 3 [ 14 ] to establish background correspondences and compare colors across frames.
blocks.zh:
实体一致性比较了CLIP特征 [19] 参考定义的手和被操纵的物体,并对缺失的预测区域进行处罚.
背景一致性比背景区域衡量DINOv3特征的时间稳定性[22].
测相 一致性使用"深度Anything 3"[14]建立背景对应并比较跨帧颜色.

blocks.en:
Action Adherence evaluates requested hand behavior, while Event Adherence evaluates explicitly specified interaction events.
Both use fixed questions adapted from WBench [ 29 ] , grounded in task descriptions and annotated windows.
blocks.zh:
动作遵守评价所请求的手行为,而事件遵守评价明确指定的交互事件.
两者都使用由W Bench [29] 改编的固定问题,以任务描述和附加说明的窗口为基础.

blocks.en:
Trajectory Accuracy evaluates the motion of manipulated objects against their reference trajectories.
Causal Plausibility assesses whether visible effects follow plausibly from the interaction.
Evolution Correctness evaluates the physical plausibility of a transformation, with a progress gate accounting for whether the required change occurs.
State Regulation checks whether a specified state is established and retained in subsequent windows, accounting for permitted reversals.
blocks.zh:
轨迹精确度对照被操纵物体的参考轨迹评价被操纵物体的运动.
因果关系评估了可见效应是否从相互作用中明显地遵循.
演化正确性评价了一个变换的物理合理性,同时对是否发生需要的变换进行进取门核算.
国家法规检查是否建立了特定状态,并在随后的窗口中保留,计入允许的倒置。

blocks.en:
State Progression measures attainment of visible state milestones, including minimum-change and completion conditions.
Memory Consistency checks whether previously observed attributes remain consistent when they reappear after interaction or occlusion.
Historical and reappearance windows supply the evidence; frozen checklists specify the attributes to compare and their allowed changes.
blocks.zh:
国家进步措施 实现显著的国家里程碑,包括最低变化和完成条件。
内存一致性检查以前观察到的属性在相互作用后或被隔离后重新出现时是否仍然一致.
历史和再现窗口提供证据;被冻结的清单指定了比较的属性及其允许的更改.

blocks.zh: 3.4 HWB 分数和汇总

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate eleven models on 500 cases comprising 322 human-hand, 108 simulated dexterous-hand, and 70 real dexterous-hand interactions across seven task families and 22 task categories.
The comparison covers general-purpose video generators, including HunyuanVideo 1.5 and Wan2.2 [ 28 , 27 , 23 , 24 ] , and hand- or scene-conditioned models, such as JointControlVideo, EgoHOI, and EgoSim [ 6 , 30 , 31 , 11 , 25 , 12 , 7 ] .
We compare released configurations on shared reference cases using native visual, control, and scene inputs; details are shown in Appendix G.2.
The seventeen metrics and six-category HWBScore (Sections 3.3 – 3.4 ) yield overall results in Table 2 and complete embodiment-level results in Appendices H.1–H.3.
Generation protocols, stability, and scoring costs are detailed in Appendices G.1–G.3, I.2, and E.3.

我们评估了500个案例的11个模型,包括322个人工模型、108个模拟自制模型以及7个任务家庭和22个任务类别的70个实际自制模型。

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 总体业绩

blocks.en:
JointControlVideo leads with a HWBScore of 55.51, followed by HunyuanVideo 1.5 at 52.22 and Wan2.2 at 51.65 (Table 2 ).
Appendix I.2 specifies score and paired-difference confidence-interval estimation.
HunyuanVideo 1.5 leads visual quality and appearance consistency, while JointControlVideo gains its advantage in instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence (Figure 3 ).
Photometric Consistency favors HunyuanVideo 1.5 (0.740 versus 0.612), while State Regulation favors JointControlVideo (0.425 versus 0.240).
These measures test retaining visible scene properties and producing changed states that remain available to subsequent actions.
Selecting for appearance preservation therefore favors a different model from selecting for persistent manipulation outcomes.
blocks.zh:
联合控制 视频线索为HWBS分数55.51,后为HunyuanVideo 1.5分52.22分和Wan2.2分51.65分(表2)。
附录一.2具体规定了分数和配对-偏差信任-间距估计.
HunyuanVideo 1.5引导视觉质量和外观一致性,而"联合控制Video"则在遵循指令,物理一致性,以及时间一致性(图3 )方面获得了优势.
相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
这些措施测试了保留可见的场景属性,并产生了仍然可供以后行动的改变状态。
因此,选择外观保存与选择持续的操纵结果不同。

blocks.en:
The clearest separation occurs between variables constrained by motion inputs and the object changes that must be inferred from them.
Hand2World leads Pose Control at 0.529 but scores 0.021 on State Progression and 0.000 on State Regulation.
JointControlVideo has lower Pose Control of 0.416, yet reaches 0.385 and 0.425 on the two state metrics.
The separation extends to object motion: EgoSim leads Trajectory Accuracy at 0.276, while its Evolution Correctness is 0.057.
Geometric conditions specify how the hand should move; they leave the model to infer how contact changes the object and how that change persists.
The ranking reversal separates accurate tracking of explicit motion inputs from prediction of their object-state consequences.
blocks.zh:
最明显的分离发生在受运动输入所束缚的变量和必须从它们推断的对象变化之间.
汉德2世界领先 Pose Control在0.529分,但在国家进步方面得分为0.021分,在国家条例方面得分为0.000分.
联合控制 视频的下波斯控制为0.416,然而在两个状态度量衡上却达到了0.385和0.425.
分离延伸至物体运动: EgoSim 引出轨道精确度为 0.276,而其演化正性为 0.057.
几何条件指定了手应如何移动;它们让模型推断接触如何改变对象,以及这种改变如何持续。
排名倒转将精确跟踪显性运动输入与预测其对象状态后果区分开来.

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Embodiment and Task Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 交叉效应和任务分析

blocks.en:
JointControlVideo’s pose-tracking advantage over HunyuanVideo 1.5 persists across dexterous-hand settings, while their ordering in state prediction reverses.
On simulated dexterous hands, JointControlVideo scores 0.335 in Pose Control, compared with 0.164 for HunyuanVideo 1.5.
HunyuanVideo 1.5 nevertheless leads Evolution Correctness and State Progression at 0.323 and 0.399, versus 0.304 and 0.364.
On real dexterous hands, JointControlVideo leads both state metrics at 0.443 and 0.475, against 0.228 and 0.270.
Appendix I.1 describes controlled checks of visual context, evaluation horizon, and reference access for these comparisons.
The advantage in tracking a geometric input thus persists more consistently than the advantage in predicting its effects on objects.
blocks.zh:
联合控制 视频在HunyuanVideo 1.5的定位优势始终存在于各式各样的设定中,
在模拟的自控手上 视频在"Pose Control"中得分为0.335分,而"HunyuanVideo"的得分为0.164分.
然而,HunyuanVideo 1.5在0.323和0.399中领导了Evolution的正确性和状态进步,对0.304和0.364。
在真正的冷酷的手,联合控制 视频在0.443和0.475的状态度量衡中领先,对0.228和0.270.
附录一.1介绍了对视觉环境、评价视野和这些比较的参考访问的控制检查。
因此,跟踪几何输入的优点比预测其对物体的影响的优点更能持续。

blocks.en:
Task-level results further locate the gap between reproducing an operation and realizing its defining object relation.
In Assemble & Connect, PAM leads Action Adherence at 0.552, whereas Wan2.2 leads Evolution Correctness at 0.652.
For assembly, matching a manipulation pattern can leave the required connection between parts unrealized; the two rankings capture this distinction between recognizable behavior and its physical result.
Move & Arrange also exposes dependence on embodiment within one task family.
On real dexterous hands, JointControlVideo leads action adherence and evolution correctness at 0.563 and 0.682.
On simulated hands, it ties HunyuanVideo 1.5 in action adherence, while HunyuanVideo 1.5 leads evolution correctness.
The relative advantage of specialized control therefore depends on the embodiment–task combination and the object relation that defines successful execution.
blocks.zh:
任务级结果会进一步找到复制一个操作与实现它的定义对象关系之间的差距.
在Assemble & Connect中,PAM引导动作A遵守为0.552,而Wan2.2引导进化正性为0.652.
对于组装来说,匹配一个操纵模式可以使部分之间的必要连接未实现;两个排名捕捉到可识别行为与其物理结果之间的这种区别.
移动和排列也会暴露在一个任务家族内对浮雕的依赖.
在真正的冷酷的手,联合控制 视频引导动作遵守和演化正确度为0.563和0.682.
在模拟手上,它将HunyuanVideo 1.5连接在动作坚持上,而HunyuanVideo 1.5则引导进化正确.
因此,专门控制的相对优势取决于任务组合和界定成功执行的对象关系。

blocks.en: 4.4 Interaction Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 4.4 互动诊断

blocks.en:
Motion and outcome rankings diverge even on matched tasks: Spearman correlations across the eleven models are ρ = − 0.34 \rho=-0.34 for Pose Control–State Progression and ρ = − 0.23 \rho=-0.23 for Trajectory Accuracy–Evolution Correctness (Figure 4 (a,b)).
Task-bootstrap and leave-one-model-out checks are specified in Appendix I.1.
blocks.zh:
运动和结果的排名甚至在匹配的任务上也存在差异:11个模型的斯皮尔曼相关性为: ^ − 0.34\rho=-0.34 Pose Control - State Progression; ^ − 0.23\rho=-0.23 轨迹精确度 - Evolution 正确性(图4(a,b))。
附录一.1具体规定了 " 任务包 " 和 " 留一式 " 检查。

blocks.en:
State Progression and State Regulation share a task-achievement requirement, reflected in their strong correlation of ρ = 0.89 \rho=0.89 (Figure 4 (c)).
State Regulation gates retention credit on state establishment, so both scores depend on reaching the required state.
Yet EgoSim and CogVideoX1.5 have similar progression scores of 0.175 and 0.164, while their regulation scores are 0.036 and 0.127.
The shared prerequisite brings the overall rankings closer; subsequent retention still separates models with comparable progress.
blocks.zh:
" 国家进步 " 和 " 国家条例 " 共同提出了完成任务的要求,这体现在它们之间的强烈关联性为: ^ 0.89\rho=0.89(图4(c))。
州监管门保留信用于州立机构,因此两个分数都取决于达到要求的州.
然而"EgoSim"和"CogVideoX1.5"的进取分相近为0.175分和0.164分,而它们的调控分则为0.036分和0.127分.
共同的先决条件使总体排名更加接近;随后的保留仍然将进展相当的模型分开。

blocks.en:
Entity similarity and historical consistency operate at different levels of detail ( ρ = 0.38 \rho=0.38 ; Figure 4 (d)).
On this matched subset, JointControlVideo and HunyuanVideo 1.5 have similar entity scores but different memory retention (Appendix I.1).
Similar overall features can coexist with changes to local attributes established earlier in the interaction.
Memory evaluation therefore asks whether the current object remains faithful to its observed history.
blocks.zh:
实体的相似性和历史一致性在不同的详细级别上运作(同为0.38\rho=0.38;图4(d))。
在这个匹配的子集上,联合控制视频和Hunyuan视频1.5有相似的实体分数但内存保留不同(附录一.1)。
类似的整体特征可以与早期在相互作用中确立的本地属性的变化并存.
因此,记忆评价询问当前对象是否仍然忠实于所观察的历史.

blocks.en: 4.5 Alignment with Human Judgments
blocks.zh: 4.5 符合人类判决

blocks.en:
We collect 20,244 preference judgments from 153 participants, covering 2,911 video pairs generated by eleven models across three egocentric embodiment settings.
Each judgment records a video-pair preference for overall performance or one evaluation dimension.
blocks.zh:
我们从153名参与者那里收集了20 244项偏好判断,涵盖11个模型在3个自我中心化环境中产生的2 911个视频对。
每项判决都记录了对总体业绩或一个评价层面的影视偏好。

blocks.en:
Figure 6 shows strong alignment between automatic scores and human preferences at the model level: Spearman's ρ \rho is 0.964 for HWBScore and ranges from 0.934 to 0.991 across the six dimensions.
At the video-pair level, preference agreement is 81.7% for overall performance and ranges from 76.9% to 84.1% across the six dimensions.
Physical Consistency achieves the highest pairwise agreement of 84.1%.
Response handling and task-bootstrap confidence intervals are detailed in Appendices J.2–J.3.
blocks.zh:
图6显示在模型一级自动分数和人类偏好之间的紧密一致: Spearman的 $\rho 的HWBS分数为 0.964,从 0.934 至 0.991 不等,跨越了六个维度.
在视频拍摄方面,总体业绩的优惠协议为81.7%,6个层面的优惠协议为76.9%至84.1%。
物理一致性实现84.1%的最高对等协议.
附加J.2-J.3.中详细列出了反应处理和任务包接的置信间隔。

blocks.en: 4.6 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 定性分析

blocks.en:
During soleplate wiping, CogVideoX1.5 retains the perforation pattern, whereas DWM replaces the holes with irregular markings (Figure 6 (a)).
Wiping changes contact and visibility while the underlying pattern should persist.
The contrast exposes a failure to keep the current appearance consistent with local properties established by the object’s history, even as the manipulation continues.
blocks.zh:
在平面平面擦拭时,CogVideoX1.5保留了穿孔图案,而DWM则用不规则的标记来取而代之(图6 (a)).
鞭打会改变接触和能见度,而基本模式则应持续下去。
对比表明,即使操纵仍在继续,但目前的外观仍无法与物体历史确定的当地属性保持一致。

blocks.en:
Ball placement separates embodiment preservation from the required object relation (Figure 6 (b)).
JointControlVideo places the ball in the bowl while retaining the dexterous hands.
PAM and DWM introduce human hands, and the ball remains outside the bowl in the last displayed frame.
Continued hand motion accompanies both a change of acting embodiment and an unmet placement goal, showing how these two requirements can fail within one generated interaction.
blocks.zh:
球放入将浮雕保存与所需的对象关系相分离(图6(b))。
联合控制 视频将球放入碗中,同时保留了可调取的手.
PAM和DWM引入了人类的手,在上一个显示的框中球还留在碗外.
持续的手动同时伴随着演绎方式的改变和未达到的放置目标,表明这两项要求如何在一种产生的相互作用中失败.

blocks.en:
Carton lifting tests continuity beyond the manipulated object (Figure 6 (c)).
JointControlVideo lifts the carton but distorts the background beneath it; Hand2World replaces the dexterous hands with human hands in later frames.
As the action reveals more of the scene, the generated background must remain compatible with the surrounding structure, and the manipulator must retain its supplied embodiment throughout the operation.
Further examples appear in Appendices K.1–K.2.
blocks.zh:
受操纵物体以外的卡通起重试验连续性(图6(c))。
联合控制 视频将卡通抬起但扭曲了下方的背景;而"汉德2世界"则在后期的相框中用人手来取而代之.
由于动作揭示出更多场景,所生成的背景必须保持与周围结构相容,操纵者必须在整个行动过程中保留其提供的表现.
进一步的例子见附录K.1-K.2。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented HandWorldBench, a unified benchmark that brings human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands into a common framework of interaction tasks, control interfaces, and evaluation criteria.
A curation pipeline yields 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips, from which 500 interactions covering seven task families are manually selected for evaluation.
Across eleven models, accurate tracking of control signals does not consistently translate into the object changes and persistent states that those signals should induce.
The benefits of specialized control vary with embodiment and task, while general-purpose video generators achieve stronger interaction outcomes in several comparisons.
Strong agreement with human judgments supports the evaluation at both the model-ranking and video-pair levels.
HandWorldBench provides a common basis for assessing whether progress in motion control extends to interaction prediction that remains coherent across embodiments and tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了HandWorld Bench, 一个统一的基准, 将人类的手, 模拟的自相残杀的手, 和真正的自相残杀的手, 带入一个互动任务,控制界面, 和评价标准的共同框架。
管理管道产生20 500个以自我为中心的高质量短片,其中500个互动涉及7个任务家庭,由人工选择进行评价。
在11个模型中,对控制信号的准确跟踪不能一致地转化为物体的变化,而且这些信号应该诱发的持久性。
专门控制的好处因表现和任务而异,而通用视频生成器在几项比较中实现了更强的互动结果.
与人类判断的强烈一致支持在模型级别和视频拍摄层面的评价。
HandWorld Bench为评估运动控制方面的进展是否延伸到各种表现和任务之间始终一致的互动预测提供了一个共同的基础。
